ei.title: 이야기 — 동료 결근 속 단독 발표 완수

fullPassage: Dan and I were supposed to make a presentation that day. Right after the class started, my phone buzzed. It was a text from Dan saying, "I can't make it on time. There's been a car accident on the road!" I almost fainted. 'What should I do?' Dan didn't show up before our turn, and soon I was standing in front of the whole class. I managed to finish my portion, and my mind went blank for a few seconds, wondering what to do. 'Hold yourself together!' I quickly came to my senses and worked through Dan's part of the presentation as best as I could. After a few moments, I finished the entire presentation on my own. Only then did the tension vanish. I could see our professor's beaming face.

questions.stem:
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

Dan and I were supposed to make a presentation that day. Right after the class started, my phone buzzed. It was a text from Dan saying, "I can't make it on time. There's been a car accident on the road!" I almost fainted.

(A) I managed to finish my portion, and my mind went blank for a few seconds, wondering what to do. 'Hold yourself together!' I quickly came to my senses and worked through Dan's part of the presentation as best as I could.

(B) Dan didn't show up before our turn, and soon I was standing in front of the whole class.

(C) After a few moments, I finished the entire presentation on my own. Only then did the tension vanish. I could see our professor's beaming face.

① (B) — (A) — (C): 결근→대처→완수 ←정답

③ (C) — (A) — (B): 완수가 가장 앞에 올 수 없음
④ (B) — (C) — (A): 완수 뒤에 대처 과정 부자연
